title: Dramatic Entrance!
flavor: Welcome, welcome, one and all - to a stage-lit extravaganza for the ages! Prepare to have your senses shattered! Your expectations are demolished! Your Ancients smashed to ruins! Witness the impossible feats and derring-do of the one and only clockwork marvel, the Great Cogliostro Kettle - Ringmaster, torture artist, genius in his own time - here now for the sole agony and entertainment of any hero bold enough to draw back the crimson carnival curtain and behold what mysteries await inside.

entries.name: Ringmaster ($5, ?/?/?)
entries.detail: Ability Spotlight <Active Ability: Instant> Ringmaster shines a spotlight that sweeps an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Non-permanent pieces and illusion pieces hit by the beam will fade away, by taking a PURE damage equal to a percentage of their health each second. P.S. Ringmaster is a special Legendary piece with no Race but 3 Random Classes! The classes keep in one single match, but vary among matches.

entries.name: Lion - Finger of Death
entries.detail: Base damage increased from 300/500/900 to 500/750/1250, CD increased from 7/5/3 secs to 8/6/4 secs.

entries.name: Naga - Scale Armor
entries.detail: Simplified. (2) Nagas: All allies gain a shield that absorbs 20% ability damage. (4) Nagas: All allies gain a shield that absorbs 30% ability damage (6) Nagas: All Nagas detonate their shield every 3 secs to deal MAGICAL damage to enemies according to damage absorbed. P.S. Scale Armors cannot absorb PURE damage. P.S. (6) Nagas detonation has a trigger threshold of 100. Less than 100 absorbed damage will not detonate but accumulate into the next detonation.

entries.name: Harpy - WIndfury
entries.detail: (2) Harpies: Chance for an extra target increased from 75% to 100%.

entries.name: Aqir - Infection
entries.detail: Delay increased from 0.1 sec to 1 sec. (4) Aqirs now summon +1 Level Aqir (Chance for +2 Level canceled)

entries.name: Diffusal Blade
entries.detail: Reworked Attack damage + 20% Attack prevents target from mana recharging and Deathrattle triggering. P.S. Only one Initial target affected by Diffusal debuff on Split Shot.
